registryAssessment: The official Haridwar District Administration land-record service page explicitly links the state Bhulekh record service and locates the Collectorate at Roshnabad, Haridwar; the Hindi official page confirms the same service and place. Uttarakhand’s official Stamps and Registration Department documents property registration and offers statewide registered-document search, but the reviewed local page is land-record service evidence, not a city parcel API. No safe geometry route/schema was verified.

accessReview.reason: The English and Hindi district government pages document land-record “nakal” via the state Bhulekh portal and identify the Haridwar Collectorate/tehsil jurisdiction. The linked Bhulekh portal uses plain HTTP and is a land-record service; it was not accessed. Uttarakhand Stamps and Registration describes e-search of registered documents and property transaction registration, which is record-centric. No anonymous parcel geometry schema, stable-ID allowlist, or CRS was found; no record or map query was made.

privacy: No owner/address/tax/account/property-record query, login, or private attribute extraction was performed. No geometry retained.

runtimeAssessment.reason: Official local-government evidence confirms land records associated with Haridwar, but the state revenue and registration services are broader than the urban settlement. No city-specific parcel geometry endpoint or WUP-point parcel coverage was established.
